note: Curated for visual density, measured 2026-11-05 in muted headless Chrome (tests/e2e/probe_presets.py: tone mode, full-bundle screen then a 6 s strobe-grade pass). Coverage = fraction of pixels with luma>16; 9 of these 20 fill >=90% of the frame. strobe=true is measured, not guessed: luma-grid jumps >=12/255 at >=0.5/s, or >=25/255 peak delta. Reduced-motion users only ever see strobe=false presets. Families steer the mood engine in aura.js: idle=organic/liquid calm, thinking=geometric/fractal structure, approval=cosmic contrast, error=liquid wash under the red tint, streaming=energy.
